title: Unsupervised Clustering Approach to Identify Chemical Segregation in Atom Probe Tomography Reconstructions
content: Quantifying the composition of nanoscale regions in materials resulting from irradiation is notoriously difficult using traditional laboratory instruments. This presents challenges to characterizing irradiated components in the manner needed to determine underlying mechanisms involved in radiation-induced segregation. Atom probe tomography (APT) has been used to characterize irradiation damage in a wide range of materials [1, 2] but requires laborious workup and analysis of the data that is highly dependent on expert knowledge. To aid in the task of data analysis, we developed a robust and scalable method for the identification of compositional heterogeneity in the APT analyses of complex materials.
